e.title: Columbia 金融高级数据科学课程
e.summary: 哥伦比亚精算课程：金融中的高级数据科学应用（ACTU K5842）
e.body:
Columbia University「Advanced Data Science Applications in Finance」（ACTU K5842，2026）：金融/保险中的高级数据科学应用（课程大纲）——哥伦比亚精算系列课程之一。对 RIAA：保险/金融数据科学的名校课程——与 [[columbia-dtai-insurance]]（保险数据/技术/AI）、[[columbia-actuary-toolkit]]（精算工具）构成哥伦比亚精算教育三课；理解名校如何教高级数据科学（深度学习/高级方法在金融保险）；课程大纲 = 高级技能学习路径参考。

Columbia University's 'Advanced Data Science Applications in Finance' (ACTU K5842, 2026): advanced data-science applications in finance/insurance (course syllabus) — one of the Columbia actuarial-course series. For RIAA: a prestigious-university course of insurance/finance data science — with [[columbia-dtai-insurance]] (insurance data/tech/AI) and [[columbia-actuary-toolkit]] (actuarial tools) it forms the Columbia actuarial-education trio; understand how leading universities teach advanced data science (deep learning/advanced methods in finance and insurance); a course syllabus = an advanced-skills learning-path reference.
